test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
What will come in the place of ‘?’ in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘–’ are interchanged and also ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

13 ÷ 8 – 96 × 6 + 17 = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png] 

Given : 13 ÷ 8 – 96 × 6 + 17 = ?

After '+' and ‘-' are interchanged and '×' and ‘÷' are interchanged then,

13 ÷ 8 – 96 × 6 + 17 = ? ⇒ 13 × 8 + 96 ÷ 6
